in_marathi.name: Devapriya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devapriya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from Sanskrit words ‘Deva’ (God) and ‘Priya’ (Delight). It is a name signifying the divine pleasure and happiness that the deity brings into one's life.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's delight
